turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, hi. Before we go on, how much do you take to reserve a place?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good question. To reserve a property we take a holding deposit of one week's rent, and it goes toward your first month's rent once the tenancy is signed.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, and for the Elm Road flat that would be what, about three hundred and twenty?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Roughly, yes. The rent is fourteen hundred a month, so one week works out at about three hundred and twenty three pounds.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, that's manageable. I'd like to see it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We have viewings Monday to Friday between nine and six. What suits you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Tuesday after work, maybe half five?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tuesday at five thirty is booked. You'll get a text confirming it with the address in a moment.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, have a good evening.
